Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meera - 10 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Sunita - 40 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Manoj - 42 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rohan stands in the park. Meera, Sunita and Manoj stand near him.]

Meera: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rohan goes jogging in the park.]

Rohan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Meera skips rope.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Rohan: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan starts crying.]

Rohan: "What happened?"

[Rohan smiles at Mother.]

Rohan: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Rohan stamps his foot in anger.]

Rohan: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Meera stands in the living room. Rohan, Sunita and Manoj stand near her.]

Manoj: "What a nice place."

[Meera applies kajal to her eyes.]

Rohan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rohan gulps down a glass of milk.]

Rohan (surprised): "Show me too!"

[Rohan studies for his exam.]

Rohan (gently): "Really?"

[Rohan talks to his father on the phone.]

Sunita: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan slams the door shut.]

Rohan: "How beautiful!"

Scene 4: The bathroom - Day

[Rohan stands in the bathroom. Sunita, Meera and Manoj stand near him.]

Rohan: "What a nice place."

[Rohan brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Rohan: "That's great!"

[Rohan takes a quick bath.]

Sunita (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
